distribution: Liping, Rongjiang, Congjiang, Libo and Leishan, Guizhou.
soldier: The head is pale yellow, the mandibles purplish brown, the pronotum pale yellow, the legs still paler, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.58, the sides slightly narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin almost straight. In lateral view the frontal ridge is distinctly raised; in dorsal view the two ridges project like tubercles, connected in the middle by a shallow groove that leads to the fontanelle pore. The labrum is spear-shaped with a narrowly rounded apex, apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are stout and strong, their apices very strongly curved, the mandibular condyle visible, that of the left mandible 0.50–0.62 of the head capsule length and 0.93–1.09 of the head width. Antennae with 17 segments. The postmentum is narrow and long, nine to twelve times as long as the waist width, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.35, the head width seven to eight times the waist width. The pronotum is 1.47–1.66 times as wide as long, both the anterior and the posterior margin broadly arcuate and concave in the middle, the lateral margins gently oblique backwards, with about thirty long hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
